7bdguu4k4i7pg484lm1r1gt9dv.summary: The last meeting with the consortium on August 27 focused on the critical security gap in outbound two-way SMS—specifically the lack of an automated, centralized Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solution to monitor sensitive data. You evaluated enforcement points across endpoint, application, and inline API layers—noting that Broadcom and Proofpoint currently lack the necessary integration capabilities. To resolve this, the consortium agreed to benchmark industry peer practices and assess existing enterprise tools—like CrowdStrike and Island—to enforce local browser controls.
tasks: Review the industry peer research from Max Kowalski to benchmark how competitors architect outbound free-text DLP workflows.
Evaluate the capabilities of existing enterprise tools—including CrowdStrike, Cyera, and Island—to enforce local browser controls.
Consult DLP vendor partners regarding Guidewire and API integration capabilities to address the current outbound texting security gap.
Resolve the outstanding InfoSec constraints regarding outbound free-text messaging before initiating any broad claims pilot rollout.
